items.title: Arrangement of Skeletal Muscles at Moveable Joints (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Arrangement of Skeletal Muscles at Moveable Joints: a main subheading of 12.3 Muscles, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 278-279.

blocks.text: Skeletal muscles haddiyon se sakht connective tissue ke zariye jure hote hain jinhen tendons kehte hain. Aam taur par ek muscle do mukhtalif haddiyon se jura hota hai. Jo sira sukarne ke waqt na hilne wali haddi se jura ho use origin kehte hain, aur jo sira hilne wali haddi se jura ho use insertion kehte hain. Muscle ke beech ke mote hisse ko belly kehte hain (Fig. 12.24).

Jor par haddi ko do simton mein hilane ke liye muscles joron (pairs) mein kaam karte hain. Sukarne par yeh ulti (opposing) harkat karte hain. Muscles ki is tarteeb ko antagonistic arrangement kehte hain. Is mein jab ek muscle, jise flexor kehte hain, sukarta hai to jor par haddi ko mor deta hai. Jab mukhalif muscle, jise extensor kehte hain, sukarta hai to haddi ko seedha kar deta hai.

blocks.alt: Mura hua bazu pehlu se: oopar baen mukka, kohni tak neeche aati forearm jis mein ulna aur radius hain, aur kandhe tak oopar jata upper arm. Biceps humerus ke aage scapula ke paas apne origins se, belly se guzar kar, tendon ke zariye radius par insertion tak; triceps humerus ke peechhe apne origins se kohni ke peechhe insertion tak. Mukke ke paas neele teer flexion aur extension dikhate hain.

blocks.text: Is antagonistic amal mein jab ek muscle (maslan flexor) sukarta hai to doosra (extensor) dheela hota hai, aur is ka ulat bhi.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Origin woh sira hai jo na hilne wali haddi (scapula) se jura hai, insertion woh jo hilne wali haddi se. Biceps sukarta hai to radius ko upar kheench kar kohni morta hai (flexion); triceps sukarta hai to ulna ko kheench kar bazu seedha karta hai (extension). Ek sukarta hai to doosra dheela parta hai: yeh antagonistic jora hai.
Ghutne ke jor par harkat (Movement at Knee Joint)

Ghutne ka jor femur (raan ki haddi) aur tibia aur fibula (nichli taang ki haddiyon) ke beech hai. Nichli taang ko morna (flexion) hamstrings karte hain. Hamstrings raan ke peechhe teen muscles ka group hai. Hamstrings ka origin pelvic girdle aur femur ke oopar ke hisse par hai, aur insertion fibula aur tibia ke oopri hisson par.

blocks.alt: Ghutne ki haddiyon (femur, patella, tibia aur fibula) ke do qareebi pehlu ke manzar. Baen: raan ke peechhe hamstrings sukarte hain aur nichli taang mur jati hai (flexed); dheele quadriceps nahin dikhaye gaye. Daen: raan ke aage quadriceps patella ke zariye kheench kar sukarte hain aur nichli taang seedhi ho jati hai (extended); dheele hamstrings nahin dikhaye gaye. Neele mure teer harkat dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.25: Ghutne ke jor par harkat (kitab ki Figure 12.25 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Nichli taang ko seedha karna (extension) quadriceps karte hain. Quadriceps raan ke aage chaar muscles ka group hai. Quadriceps ka origin ilium (pelvic girdle ka hissa) aur femur par hai, aur insertion patella (ghutne ki chapni) aur tibia par. Jab hamstrings sukarte hain to nichli taang mur jati hai aur quadriceps dheele hote hain. Jab quadriceps sukarte hain to nichli taang seedhi ho jati hai aur hamstrings dheele hote hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har taang mein sirf sukarne wala patha dikhaya gaya hai, jaisa kitab mein hai. Hamstrings peechhe se kheench kar ghutna morte hain; quadriceps aage se patella ke zariye kheench kar ghutna seedha karte hain. Yeh bhi ek antagonistic jora hai.
